population: 202,194 children represented in the study dataset
study_design: geospatial observational analysis using survey data and flood-zonation maps
effect_direction: flood-affected areas had higher risk / prevalence of low or very low birth weight
statistical_methods: bivariate analysis; multinomial logistic regression; Moran's I statistics; Geographically Weighted Regression (GWR); LISA cluster analysis
evidence_sentence: Multinomial logistic regression reveals 8 % and 27 % higher risks for LBW and VLBW in flood-affected regions.
